name: San Martín y Mudrián (Spain)
description: Yellow field charged with three green eradicated pines in a row, within a border of blue and white.
history: San Martín y Mudrián adopted its arms and flag officially on 23 May 2005, published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 16 August 2005; the flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, formed of a yellow cloth with three green eradicated pines in fess and a bordure.

border of blue with white at the hoist and fly
